description:
SDK versions are pinned to specific API versions.
Database
Use the Database API to store and query records in Pinecone Database. The following Pinecone SDKs support the Database API:
CLI
Python SDK
Node.js SDK
Java SDK
Go SDK
Inference
Use the Inference API to generate vector embeddings and rerank results using embedding models and reranking models hosted on Pinecone’s infrastructure. There are two ways to use the Inference API:
- As a standalone service, through the Rerank documents and Generat
